verdicts.quote: “Authenticate with Bright Data using 1 of 2 methods: API Access with an API key… An API key is a secure hashed token… We create a default key for you upon account creation automatically.” ([docs.brightdata.com](https://docs.brightdata.com/api-reference/authentication))
verdicts.reason: The official auth page specifies API key–based access (and even auto-creates a key), with no public OAuth flow documented.

verdicts.quote: “Get 5,000 free credits per month, no credit card, across Web Unlocker API, SERP API, Web Scraper API, Scraper Studio and Browser API.” ([docs.brightdata.com](https://docs.brightdata.com/general/account/billing-and-pricing/free-tier))
verdicts.reason: The vendor’s billing docs confirm a recurring free tier with self‑serve signup and immediate usable credits. (Note: proxies are excluded; unfunded accounts have a 1,000 rpm cap, but credentials are self‑serve.)

verdicts.quote: Left nav lists multiple API families: “Data extraction … Scraper API … Scraper Studio API … Dataset Marketplace API … Web Unlocker API … Browser API … SERP API … Web search … Business Search API … AI training data … Web Archive API … Media Data API … Proxy … Proxy Networks … Proxy Manager API … Administrative APIs … Account Management API.” ([docs.brightdata.com](https://docs.brightdata.com/api-reference/account-management-api/Get_free_tier_credits))
verdicts.reason: The API reference spans many product areas and dozens of endpoints across extraction, search, datasets, browser, proxies, and admin, which meets “broad.”

verdicts.quote: “Use the Bright Data MCP server to give AI agents real-time access to public web data with 5,000 free requests per month and zero infrastructure setup.” ([docs.brightdata.com](https://docs.brightdata.com/products/mcp-server/overview))
verdicts.reason: This is Bright Data’s own MCP server product page, confirming an official vendor‑maintained MCP server.

verdicts.quote: “We create a default key for you upon account creation automatically.” ([docs.brightdata.com](https://docs.brightdata.com/api-reference/authentication))
verdicts.reason: Self‑serve credentials plus comprehensive docs and a free tier indicate Composio could ship now. Caveats (not blockers): free‑tier rate limits and optional SSL/KYC for native proxy mode; API‑key access works without those.
